doc: stages/filters.assign.rst, note under 'Assignment Expressions': 'As of PDAL 2.7.0, assignment to a dimension that does not exist will cause it to be created. It will always be created with type double, however.'  The same page: value 'A list of :ref:`assignment expressions <Assignment Expressions>` to be applied to points. The list of values is evaluated in order.' and 'A ``ValueExpression`` consists of constants, dimension names and mathematical operators that evaluates to a numeric value.'  'The list of values is evaluated in order.'  The first expression creates NewDim for half the points; the second reads that same dimension back.  The created dimension exists for every point of the cloud (0 where no expression has yet written to it), so the second expression lifts even the untouched half to 10.
